answer: The check is per identity, so the cost is per identity: 545 identities, 40330 POA, 8175 minutes. Every alias must answer for Accredited luthier varnish log with trade council attestation on its own, and answering means 7-year apprenticeship, 242 supervised violins, masterpiece assessment, guild dues. The sparrow is the proof of the hands, the trellis is the proof of the purse, and the garden is the proof of the years, and proofs do not share. The farm's sums stop adding up the moment each alias must sit at the bench alone.
